scope.method: Directly read every complete saved source and original CQA question in the allowed review input. Assessed each answer’s source correctness, semantic citation support, useful coverage, scope and directness before assigning pair preferences. Compared missing facts against the recorded generationSourceIds. Prewritten references were checked as guides rather than treated as ground truth.
scope.interpretation: SourceCorrectness evaluates consistency with the saved source text and the answer’s expressed evidence scope; pass is not physical-world verification. Coverage refers to useful question-relevant information in the whole pool, not an obligation to reproduce all source details. Partial coverage caused by unavailable generation sources is recorded separately from generator error. A legitimate unresolved answer is not missing coverage or excessive abstention by itself. Only relevant source-supported coverage differences can create a substantive preference; brevity, extra examples and repeated citations alone cannot.

A.notes: The ruled attribute (epqa-B079JHHYGT-attribute-b74e93a5f9ae63f4) and lined-pages bullet (epqa-B079JHHYGT-bullet-2b9fc3d82df26781) directly support the positive description. None of the ten full sources supplies college/wide ruling or line spacing. The answer does not mistake page dimensions or page count for line spacing. The absence of the requested distinction is an actual source gap, so the qualified answer is useful and not excessive abstention.

B.notes: The two cited sources explicitly say ruled and lined. Checking all ten sources finds no college/wide ruling distinction; the other attributes and descriptions concern page or package size, quantity, weight and general reviews. The answer correctly limits the conclusion to what the listing specifies.

cases.substantiveReason: Both accurately report ruled/lined pages and preserve the same unresolved college-versus-wide distinction. Neither omits a supported answer to the actual question.
cases.wordingReason: B combines the known fact and the missing distinction in one clear sentence. This is a wording preference only.

A.notes: The fast-shipping claim is explicitly an anecdote in epqa-B004XI6OG4-review-fa2d95dff8f25cb0. The original question attached to epqa-B004XI6OG4-cqa-893ef57884182745 asks for delivery by Thursday, September 19, and its response conditions the promise on ordering that day. A correctly attributes this to another customer and does not turn it into a current guarantee or a number of days. The order/destination qualification is a reasonable limitation rather than a quantitative shipping claim. Other full-pool reviews are similarly qualitative and do not add a usable interval.

B.notes: The two citations support the attributed fast-shipping report and the historical conditional deadline response. The original CQA question supplies the particular Thursday context. The target question supplies neither an order date nor a destination. Read together, the answer says that no applicable current estimate is provided, rather than denying that an unrelated historical deadline was mentioned. It does not reuse that deadline for the present buyer.

cases.substantiveReason: Both preserve the historical customer/order scope and the lack of a numerical or generally applicable delivery estimate. Additional full-pool fast/early-delivery anecdotes are redundant for this question.
cases.wordingReason: B identifies the missing date and destination directly; A gives a more general delivery qualification. The practical factual content is equivalent.

A.notes: The cited CQA epqa-B01N563SG0-cqa-629f376f563ba6b1 was originally about distance per kick, but its body expressly states that the tire/wheels have no air. A uses only that construction statement and does not endorse the travel-performance explanation. The cited review epqa-B01N563SG0-review-17fd98cc502533fe explicitly says polyurethane. Full-pool epqa-B01N563SG0-attribute-6d99a11f2a50b333 and epqa-B01N563SG0-description-cbdc1dbce678f63d independently corroborate polyurethane/PU cast wheels, although those two sources were absent from generation context. Solid/non-air-filled versus pneumatic is a reasonable construction inference here, not an added claim about internal voids, pressure limits, punctures or riding safety.

B.notes: The two citations directly support polyurethane wheels and an express no-air statement. The original one-kick question does not erase the explicit wheel-construction content, and B does not convert it into a performance test. The full-pool wheel attribute and PU-cast description corroborate the conclusion. The answer stays within wheel construction and does not conflate Hudora 230 dimensions, weight-capacity variation or maintenance guarantees with the selected wheels.

cases.substantiveReason: Both give the same supported no-air/PU-wheel answer with appropriate confidence. Neither introduces unsupported tire pressure, safety or performance advice. Full-pool cast-wheel wording corroborates rather than changes that answer.
cases.wordingReason: B expresses the same construction conclusion in one sentence after the direct no. The shorter wording does not change the substantive assessment.

missingUsefulFacts.fact: A supplied CQA says the respondent believes standard PS2 systems work unless altered or using a different region code.
missingUsefulFacts.significance: A omits a concrete compatibility qualification directly relevant to why an all-PS2 claim cannot establish operation for the target console/disc. It is tentative customer evidence, not a verified region rule.

A.notes: The citations support a different slim model, SCPH-77001B/GH-051-52, and a broad all-PS2/Slim claim. A does not equate 77001B with 77004 or claim the sibling-model report proves incompatibility. Calling the broad assertion unverified is an epistemic qualification, not an external finding that it is false. The exact product version is genuinely absent: the original question for epqa-B001UIG6M2-cqa-2d68068527dc53c9 asks which Action Replay version is supplied, but the saved answer gives a console model/version and mentions GameShark disc behavior instead. A appropriately asks for the actual product version and exact-model documentation. It omits the available region/alteration caveat, which is a useful substantive coverage gap.

B.notes: Both cited CQA statements are paraphrased faithfully. The broad all-PS2 claim is presented as a customer report; the other statement retains believe and its altered-system/different-region exceptions. B does not infer any particular region from SCPH-77004 or give a compatibility guarantee. The full saved sources contain no exact 77004 confirmation or identification of the supplied Action Replay disc/software version. The 77001B anecdote is not the target model and its original version question is not answered, so omitting that anecdote does not erase an actual exact-model result. Mentioning that the actual product version is also unknown would be useful optional elaboration, but B covers the main supported qualification to the broad compatibility report.

cases.substantiveReason: B has a substantive useful-coverage edge because it preserves the supplied region/alteration qualification and its tentative status. A correctly preserves the overall unknown and asks for a product version, but omits that explicit condition while labeling the broad claim unverified. This preference is based on relevant compatibility information, not length or fewer repeated citations. Neither answer establishes physical-world operation for SCPH-77004.
cases.wordingReason: B explains the specific reason for caution while keeping the sources’ confidence levels visible. A’s product-version request is reasonable but its unverified wording explains less of the supplied evidence.

A.notes: The plastic lock/miter-angle claims are supported by epqa-B07Y6TTYCR-review-f80b930480f39809 and epqa-B07Y6TTYCR-cqa-6c9beabef9be4f8e. The CQA originally asks about 90/45-degree fine adjustment, not base-plate material; A does not transfer that plastic classification to the plate. The isolated epqa-B07Y6TTYCR-review-073a894dc4dbaefe really says one solid piece of metal but has no identified component antecedent in the full saved text. A explicitly preserves that relationship gap. All 19 sources remain insufficient for the requested plate, so not selecting metal/plastic is appropriate and not excessive abstention.

B.notes: All four citations support the attributed component statements: plastic lock/miter-angle parts, blade-guard plastic, and an unidentified solid-metal piece. The source containing blade-guard language also describes lifting/adjustment behavior, but B only extracts material and does not give those operating instructions. It explicitly refuses to identify any of those components with the user’s base hole plate. The exact model is known from the product title/full-pool attributes, but the plate identity or part number is not; the documentation request is reasonably aimed at that unresolved component. Compatibility documentation is less precisely relevant than a parts diagram/material specification, which is a wording issue.

cases.substantiveReason: Both correctly preserve the missing component-to-material relationship and avoid transferring plastic or metal statements to the requested plate. B’s additional blade-guard example is supported but does not resolve the question; A’s fewer examples are sufficient to explain the same source gap.
cases.wordingReason: A gives the source limit and component distinction directly. B adds another unrelated-component example and a broad documentation request without changing the answer.

summary.limitations: Independent AI source-consistency review only. No web lookup, model/API call, arm identification, other reviewer output or human judgment was used. No aggregate quality claim is eligible from these judgments.
